### Fixes
- **Status bar info disappeared:** after the mouse passed over a menu item the version info was cleared and never came back. It now stays visible; menu hints show over it briefly and then go away. Python and PyQt versions are in the tooltip of the info.
- **English interface:** the "Excel / Data Export", "Viewers (HTML)" and "Colors and Fonts…" labels stayed in Turkish in English mode; they are translated now.
- Emojis were removed from the group titles and the Colors and Fonts button.
- **macOS package:** it could not be built for v2.40.0 (GitHub retired the old macOS runner); this release tries again (experimental).
